reels.title: Jesus to Herod: "I have no time for you, I am not afraid of you"
reels.hook: Jesus called a powerful king – a fox
reels.why: A surprising image (Jesus insulting a king) and a clear explanation of a Jewish proverb. Ends with a strong, quotable message about fearlessness.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
speakers: Host (according to metadata, the episode was prepared by Vladimir Grebenar, PhD, Bacc. Theol.)
reels.quote: I have no time for you. You are not important, you are not God. I am not afraid of you. I do the will of God.

cards.text: Jesus called a powerful king – a fox
Vladimir Grebenar, PhD · Ora et Labora
Lk 13:31-35: Pharisees inform Jesus that Herod wants to kill him.
Jesus is not afraid of Herod. He even calls Herod a fox.
"Today, tomorrow, and the third day" – a Jewish expression for "I am too busy"
I have no time for you. You are not important, you are not God. I am not afraid of you.

reels.title: Why doesn't God's armor protect the back?
reels.hook: One part of the body remains without armor. Do you know which one?
reels.why: Opens with a riddle (which part of the body is not protected) and ends with a memorable question for the viewer. Combines faith and relationships into one clear point.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
speakers: Host (according to metadata, the episode was prepared by Vladimir Grebenar, PhD, Bacc. Theol.)
reels.quote: Who has your back? You have to know who has your back.

cards.text: One part of the body remains without armor. Do you know which one?
Vladimir Grebenar, PhD · Ora et Labora
Saint Paul in Eph 6 describes the spiritual armor: breastplate, shield, helmet, and sword.
We have to trust one another.
There is no worse sin than betrayal.
Who has your back? You have to know who has your back.

reels.title: "Truth" and "true" are not the same
reels.hook: Everyone speaks truthfully. Few speak the truth.
reels.why: A clear, unexpected distinction illustrated with a concrete example (three nations, three interpretations of the same war). Ends with a well-rounded point.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
speakers: Host (according to metadata, the episode was prepared by Vladimir Grebenar, PhD, Bacc. Theol.)
reels.quote: Truth and truthful it is. That is not the same, brothers and sisters.

cards.text: Everyone speaks truthfully. Few speak the truth.
Vladimir Grebenar, PhD · Ora et Labora
Paul in the Epistle to the Ephesians calls: "Fasten the belt of truth around your waist."
Truth and truthful it is. That is not the same.
nations – three interpretations of the same war in BiH
And the truth is only one. That is what happened.

reels.title: "I am waiting, I have work to do" – that is bland faith
reels.hook: God called you, and you put it in 10th place?
reels.why: A recognizable everyday situation and a sharp assessment ("bland faith"). Offers practical advice: do what is of God first, in the morning.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
speakers: Host (according to metadata, the episode was prepared by Vladimir Grebenar, PhD, Bacc. Theol.)
reels.quote: That is limp. That is bland. That is that is bland faith.

cards.text: God called you, and you put it in 10th place?

Interpretation of the verse: "Fasten your feet with the readiness of the gospel of peace."
That is limp. That is bland. That is bland faith.
place in the day – that is where many put God's task
Brothers and sisters, one should first do what is of God in the morning.

reels.title: The breastplate of righteousness is as heavy as a bulletproof vest
reels.hook: Doing God's will is not easy – here is why
reels.why: Combines personal testimony from prayer and a childhood memory of a bulletproof vest into a tangible image. The message is clear: a heavy burden, but also protection.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
speakers: Host (according to metadata, the episode was prepared by Vladimir Grebenar, PhD, Bacc. Theol.)
reels.quote: You cannot put on the breastplate of righteousness; rather, God must give it to you.

cards.text: Doing God's will is not easy – here is why
Vladimir Grebenar, PhD · Ora et Labora
Eph 6: "breastplate of righteousness" is part of the armor of God.
As soon as you start doing the will of God, God sends angels and saints with much greater protection upon you and your home.
You cannot put on the breastplate of righteousness; rather, God must give it to you.
As a child, he once put on a bulletproof vest – a jacket that protects against a bullet.

speakers: Host (according to metadata, the episode was prepared by Vladimir Grebenar, PhD, Bacc. Theol.)
